method: normalized character 5-gram Jaccard nearest neighbor plus longest-common-substring guard
threshold_defense: A generated sample is flagged near-copy if char-5gram Jaccard is at least 0.82, or if it shares a contiguous span of at least 48 characters with an accepted train shard, or if at least 90% of a 32+ character output is one contiguous train-corpus span. The Jaccard test catches distributed overlap; the substring guard catches verbatim copying.
